revision_history.reason: Added pitfall: Tasks, Conversations, and Messages are separate CRM entities with different ID types (UUID vs integer). Passing a task UUID to list_messages causes InvalidTextRepresentation errors. Session where this happened: drain cycle 2026-06-11.

Pitfalls were documented but buried at the bottom. Session evidence: agent re-searched the same channel 3x and searched for bare company name 'Quartz' returning mineral results — both violations of existing pitfalls. Restructuring to surface critical checks as a pre-action checklist at the top of the skill so they're encountered before any tool calls are made.

Added pitfall: "Apollo 403 ≠ bad credentials" — session showed Apollo tool routing to deprecated endpoint while the key was valid. Captured the diagnosis sequence (curl the raw API, check tool source routing) as a durable pattern for debugging API 403s across external integrations.
